bullets: Planned and executed procurement for 7+ infrastructure and automation projects (Fin line upgrade, PLC panel installation, Argon gas mixture upgradation, machinery expansion) worth 4 crore+, ensuring 100% on-time completion.
Implemented RACI matrices across cross-functional teams, clarifying responsibilities and improving task ownership, resulting in a 25% reduction in communication delays and faster project execution.
Coordinated with 7+ internal departments and 100+ suppliers to align sourcing schedules with project milestones, improving on-time material delivery (OTD) by 85%.
Procured and managed supply of key raw materials including CRCA, HRCA, Zinc, Wood, Paint, Pipes, and Structural Steel to ensure uninterrupted production and on-time project delivery.
Efficiently managed and controlled 90% of total purchase cost attributed to raw materials, ensuring cost-effective project execution.

Negotiated contracts and signed MOUs with key suppliers (JSW, POSCO, AMNS, TATA Steel, Jindal, Hindustan Zinc, GWP, AKZO, Sherwin Williams, Goodluck India, etc.), achieving 25% cost savings and improving supplier lead times by 10%.
Developed and maintained 3-month rolling procurement plans, reducing material shortages by 30% and project delays
Implemented risk mitigation strategies (alternate sourcing, performance monitoring) to cut material disruption incidents by 30%.
Managed the end-to-end P2P cycle (vendor onboarding to payment), achieving 98% invoice accuracy and ensuring full compliance with company policies.
Onboarded 20+ new suppliers, expanding the vendor base by 10% and ensuring long-term project supply stability.
Designed and tracked 10+ procurement KPIs through dashboards, enhancing supplier evaluation accuracy and reducing purchase cycle time by 20%.
Made outsourcing plans, conducted price comparisons, and finalized vendor orders according to project material requirements.
Monitored and optimized inventory levels, maintaining in-house stock balance and eliminating excess inventory or stock-out situations.
Managed and executed 20+ production and process improvement projects, achieving a 20% increase in operational efficiency through automation and workflow optimization.
Planned and scheduled daily production activities to ensure optimal utilization of machines, manpower, and materials, contributing to a 15% improvement in throughput.
Supervised a 10-member team and optimized manpower allocation, achieving zero downtime across critical production lines.
Reduced production cycle time by 15% through process mapping, Lean methodologies, and workflow redesign.
Led 5S and Lean implementation across the plant, reducing material wastage by 12% and improving overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) by 10%.
Improved on-time delivery from 80% to 95% by integrating procurement, stores, and quality teams into unified project planning cycles.
Collaborated with design and project teams to execute custom client orders worth 5 crore+, ensuring 100% compliance with technical specifications and project deadlines.
Managed ITSM processes for incident, service request, and change management, improving system response time by 25% and minimizing production impact.
Reduced ERP downtime by 20% through proactive maintenance scheduling, database optimization, and effective vendor coordination.
Developed and maintained ITSM documentation, workflows, and training materials for production and support teams, ensuring standardized operations and faster issue resolution.
Ensured accurate documentation of production data for internal audits and ISO compliance, maintaining 100% audit readiness.
Prepared and presented weekly project progress and KPI reports to senior management, enabling data-driven decision-making and improved resource planning.
Handled team scheduling, workload distribution, and conflict resolution, maintaining high team efficiency and consistent project performance. INTERNSHIP EXPERIENCE:
Supported procurement execution for multiple product line expansion projects, managing 1 crore+ worth of materials and ensuring timely delivery aligned with production schedules.
Onboarded 30+ new suppliers, achieving 20% cost savings and maintaining 100% adherence to quality standards.
Analysed commodity market trends to forecast pricing fluctuations and optimize purchasing decisions.
Developed supplier performance metrics that improved on-time delivery by 25%, reduced material rejection rates by 20%, enhancing vendor reliability, and reducing procurement risks.
Collaborated cross-functionally with production and quality teams to align material planning with project timelines, reducing delays by 15%.
Prepared project-wise procurement reports and cost analyses, enabling data-driven decision-making and improving budget accuracy by 25%.
